name: Slimy Solution: the map marks both murloc shores that carry the spittle
contract: Quest 17003 'Slimy Solution' is collected with Simple Crystal Vial 157006 from the Murloc Foragers (46) and Lurkers (732) around the lake at Eastvale Lodging Camp and is credited through the kill-credit creature 300220, which has no spawn in the world at all - the credit comes from the spellhit hook rev_20260923_01_coa_elwynn_quests.sql puts on the murlocs. Until rev_20261007_30 the only quest_poi row 17003 had was its turn-in pin (id 0, ObjectiveIndex -1, Tower of Azora), so a player carrying the open quest saw nothing on the world map for the objective (#6754). This case asks the server for 17003's points the way the quest log does - the CMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY a real client sends and the SMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY_RESPONSE it answers with - and reads the fields out of the packet itself, so the whole server-to-client path is covered rather than the database rows. The first query is a control for a quest the character does not carry (17002), which must come back with no points at all; the second is 17003, which must answer with its untouched turn-in pin followed by two kill-objective areas (ObjectiveIndex 0) drawn around the west and the east murloc shore in Elwynn Forest (WorldMapAreaId 30). Because the two shores are 450 yd apart with the open lake between them, both areas are asserted corner by corner. The last two steps walk the player onto a real world murloc on each shore and show that the ground the areas cover is where those murlocs stand, which is the only way the objective can be found in game.
